# rixl_organization_invitation (Resource)

Manages member invitations to a Rixl organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rixl_organization_invitation" "engineer" {
  org_id   = var.rixl_org_id
  username = "engineer"
  role     = "ORGANIZATION_ROLE_MEMBER"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org_id` (String)
- `role` (String)

### Optional

- `username` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `decided_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `invitation_expires_at` (String)
- `organization_first_name` (String)
- `organization_last_name` (String)
- `organization_username` (String)
- `state` (String)
- `user_id` (String)
